routing_warnings.description: The requested placement of the tribute page near the magazine's end belongs to the dedicated tribute-page Requirement.
The clause requiring inclusion of articles missing from the Flat Plan also supports the dedicated cover-listed article inclusion Requirement.
The concrete empty-space failure belongs to the independently testable article-end whitespace Requirement rather than the broad layout structure.
The Heyzine branding and white-label concern belongs to the flipbook platform configuration Requirement.
The delivery of the template and source files belongs to the source-template delivery Requirement.
The client review supports successful delivery of files prepared for digital flipbook distribution but does not specifically verify balanced two-page spread behavior.
The message delivers the final PDF for Heyzine upload and is better routed as an implementation claim for the flipbook-ready PDF artifact than as a platform-configuration Event.
The missing page 33 image concerns placement of a supplied image used to fill article-page whitespace, not remediation of image resolution.
The resizing, trim/bleed, unsafe-zone, and near-trim observations concern advertisement page-safe sizing rather than rendering sharpness.
The client reports blurry advertisements, which concerns rendering sharpness rather than page-safe sizing.
The freelancer states that the advertisements will be replaced with supplied PSD versions and corrected, but does not establish a page-safe sizing rule.
The reported manual and AI-assisted advertisement repairs support rendering quality, not advertisement sizing within page safety boundaries.
